fmus.name: ThermalController
fmus.description: Supervisory thermal controller for battery pack. Tracks driver power request but derates based on SOC, voltage, and core temperature. Commands battery current, pump and fan. Includes integral action and hysteresis mode switching.

ports.name: driver_power_request_W
ports.description: Requested traction electrical power from driver (positive demand).

ports.name: I_min_A
ports.description: Minimum discharge current command (no regen in this scenario).

ports.name: soc_min
ports.description: SOC lower limit for allowing power.

ports.name: V_min_V
ports.description: Voltage lower limit for allowing power.

ports.name: kP_current
ports.description: Proportional gain mapping requested power to current via I=P/V * kP_current.

ports.name: ambient_ff_gain
ports.description: Ambient temperature feedforward for cooling (more cooling at high ambient).

fmus.name: CoolantLoopPlant
fmus.description: 简化冷却回路：泵命令驱动换热系数 UA(pump_cmd)（非线性饱和），冷却液温度为一阶动态并与环境换热。

ports.name: heat_in_W
ports.description: 进入冷却回路的热量（来自电池包）（W）

ports.name: coolant_temp_C
ports.description: 回路代表性冷却液温度（°C）

ports.name: heat_removed_W
ports.description: 通过散热器向环境移除的热量（W）

ports.name: ua_min_WK
ports.description: 最小等效 UA（泵低速/停转时仍有少量自然对流）

ports.name: ua_max_WK
ports.description: 最大等效 UA（泵高速时饱和）

ports.name: ua_shape
ports.description: UA(pump_cmd) 非线性形状参数（指数/曲率）

ports.name: pump_rate_limit_per_s
ports.description: 泵内部状态变化率限制
